items.point: Only the complete patch fully mitigates the wider state issue.
items.quote: The complete patch resets this wider state because it must not survive into operations that precede normal initialization.
For PHP 8.5 installations that cannot update, set fatal_error_backtraces=0 administratively and restart every worker.
For the session lifecycle case, set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 administratively and restart every worker.
If performance is not a factor, consider limiting the number of requests a worker may execute using pm.max_requests=1.
Enable log_errors=On, a functional error_log, and error_reporting=E_ALL in startup configuration during an isolated audit.

Updating to a release containing the complete state reset patch is the only reliable mitigation.
There is no configuration based mitigation that covers every such operation.
